# About

This textbook will illustrate how to choose and use common statistical techniques in psychology.

## Learning objectives 

1. Describe the difference between exploratory and confirmatory research
2. Describe statistical significance and clinical significance 
3. Match research designs to statistical tests
4. Use JASP statistical software
5. Apply knowledge of statistics to statistical testing 
6. Generate and interpret statistical analyses and graphs
